title: BlueBlocks: FHIR R4 Integration Plugin Design
description:
Design and implement FHIR R4 (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) integration plugin.

## Why Critical
- Industry standard for healthcare data exchange
- Required by ONC for certified health IT
- 90%+ of modern healthcare systems support FHIR

## Plugin Requirements

### FHIR Resources to Support
- Patient
- Practitioner
- Organization
- Encounter
- Observation
- DiagnosticReport
- MedicationRequest
- Condition
- Procedure
- AllergyIntolerance
- Immunization
- DocumentReference

### Features
- FHIR R4 resource validation
- Resource mapping to BlueBlocks records
- SMART on FHIR authentication
- Bulk data export/import
- Subscription notifications

### Integration Points
- HAPI FHIR server compatibility
- Epic, Cerner, Allscripts APIs
- Apple Health Records
- Google Health Connect
